name: OpenBao-based Postgres access request and temporary credential system

mentions.name: OpenBao-based Postgres access request and temporary credential system
mentions.description: This tool sits on top of OpenBao to generate temporary Postgres credentials and roles. A website lets people request database access, and a designated group of people approves requests; after approval, database users can request time-limited temporary credentials from OpenBao for a specific number of hours.
mentions.source_excerpt: I just put something similar together but then on top of Openbao which generates temporary credentials/roles for Postgres. I created a website where people can request access and a specific group of people can approve the approve. After being approved, the database users can request temporary credentials in OpenBao for a specific number of hours.
